newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan to send first expedition to Everest.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan to send first expedition to Everest.

text.p: Pakistan will next week send its first expedition to scale Mount Everest to mark the 50th anniversary of the country's independence.

Nazir Ahmed Sabir, 43, Pakistan's best known climber, will lead the 10-man team to the 8,848-metre (29,028-foot) peak, which straddles Nepal and China, Alpine Club of Pakistan president Amir Gulistan Janjua told a news conference on Thursday.
He said the team, to be joined by three Chinese climbers, would climb the world's highest peak between May and June from its northern side, which lies in Tibet.
